title: The 5 Best Patio Heaters for Tables
h1: The 5 Best Patio Heaters for Tables
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for patio heaters for tables, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at patio heaters for tables using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fire Sense 60262 Tabletop Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 10,000 BTU propane burner, Stainless steel construction, Auto-shutoff tilt valve.
strengths: The auto-shutoff tilt valve is the strongest safety feature of any tabletop heater in this price range
Stainless steel finish matches most outdoor dining sets without looking like an accessory bolted on
10,000 BTU is a genuinely comfortable amount of heat for a 4 to 6 foot table
limitations: 1lb cylinders need swapping every few hours of continuous use
Not rated for covered or low-airflow dining spaces
No adjustable heat dial, it runs at one fixed output
features: CSA approved, runs on a 1lb cylinder

products.name: Mr. Heater 11,000 BTU Table Top Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 to 11,000 BTU adjustable output, 1lb propane cylinder compatible, Piezo push-button ignition.
strengths: Adjustable dial lets you scale heat down on milder evenings instead of one fixed setting
Piezo ignition lights consistently without a separate lighter or match
Slightly higher max BTU than the Fire Sense at full output
limitations: Lacks the auto-shutoff tilt valve featured on the Fire Sense
Runs through 1lb cylinders quickly at the higher end of its output range
Fewer long-term owner reviews than the more established Fire Sense line

products.name: Dr. Infrared Heater Carbon Infrared Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 120V / 1500W carbon infrared element, Includes a tripod for freestanding use, 3 heat settings.
strengths: The included tripod lets it stand beside a table rather than sit on it, keeping the table surface free for food
No flame near the table, an easier sell for households nervous about open-flame heaters near kids
Weatherproof rating means it can stay set up through light rain
limitations: Needs an outdoor-rated outlet within cord reach of the table
Larger footprint on the ground than a true tabletop unit
More expensive than either propane tabletop option here
features: Includes a tripod for freestanding use

products.name: Hiland HLDS032-B Tabletop Patio Heater, 11,000 BTU
strengths: Warms a table area without floor space
Runs on 1 lb or 20 lb propane
